POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.CityofSanMarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Library Board of
Trustees on any item of interest that is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Board of
Trustees. Pursuant to state law, the Library Board of Trustees may not discuss or take
action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Chair
reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up
on such items.

MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, JULY 24, 2023 AT 8:00 A.M.
  BARTH ROOM, CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

CALL TO ORDER: Chairperson Domier called the regular meeting to order at 8:03 a.m. in the
Barth Room, located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Chairperson Domier led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Alternate Wu, Trustee Derry, Vice Chairperson Sadun,
  Chairperson Domier

  ABSENT: Alternate Wahl, Trustee Chien, Trustee Osegueda

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

CEREMONIAL

1. REORGANIZATION OF THE LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES BY SELECTING
  A CHAIRPERSON AND VICE CHAIRPERSON

Chairperson Domier explained that this item will be tabled until the September meeting due to the
absence of two full members.

BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

2. CHAIRPERSON REPORT

Chairperson Domier shared how much he appreciates the members of the Board. He reminded all
that there is no meeting in August with the next meeting in September. He shared his appreciation
for the fact that the Community Services Department is really hitting their stride this summer with
an amazing number of programs.

3. TRUSTEE REPORTS

Vice Chairperson Sadun shared how pleased she was to read that the Library was extending its
hours to operate as a cooling center during the extreme weather.

Alternate Wu and Trustee Derry did not have anything to report.
 LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
JULY 24, 2023  PAGE 2 OF 3

4. CRAIN ART GALLERY LIAISON REPORT

Vice Chairperson Sadun shared that Gallery is doing extremely well. She shared that Pete Morris’
exhibit went up this past week with a reception on Saturday where he reflected on his art to about
25 attendees. She added that a watercolor exhibit will be on display through the end of August, with
the winners of the City’s Photo Contest on display through October, and Emily Suñez’s acrylics on
display from November to December.

5. FRIENDS OF THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Derry shared that the Friends did not meet in June and she is not aware of a meeting in
July.

6. SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Chien was not in attendance, but provided a written report for Chairperson Domier to
share at the meeting. Trustee Chien’s report included that the Foundation welcomed two new
members in July, scheduled the donor appreciation event on August 11 with guest speaker Naomi
Hirahara, and is planning Delicious Destinations for early 2024.

NEW BUSINESS

7. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Trustee Derry moved, seconded by Vice Chairperson Sadun, to approve the minutes of the special
meeting on May 22, 2023.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Alternate Wu, Trustee Derry, Vice Chairperson Sadun, Chairperson Domier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Alternate Wahl, Trustee Chien, Trustee Osegueda

8. DIRECTOR AND LIBRARY MANAGER REPORT

Director Johnson and Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

Vice Chairperson Sadun shared that she biked by the Library on Sunday and was amazed by the
synergy between the Library and Community Center. She added that the Library is doing a great job
of finding the area in which people are comfortable. Chairperson Domier shared that he is grateful
that the Community Center is opening earlier than expected and on budget, and was also pleased
to see the synergy between the two buildings.
